import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
# define and persist transform
program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    # Four orientations of the input in a 2x2 block arrangement.
    top_right = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]  # 90 degrees clockwise
    bottom_left = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]  # 90 degrees counterclockwise
    bottom_right = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]  # 180 degrees
    out = []
    for r in range(n):
        out.append(list(grid[r]) + top_right[r])
    for r in range(n):
        out.append(bottom_left[r] + bottom_right[r])
    return out
'''
